💡 **SUGGESTION: same helper name, swapped parameter order across the two modules**

This PR introduces two same-named "post token usage safely" guards with different signatures:

- `js/closeQuestionTicket.js:35` — `postTokenUsageCommentsSafely(ticketKey, params, tracker)`
- `js/enhanceSolutionDesignDescriptionAndAssess.js:152` — `postTokenUsageCommentsSafely(params, ticketKey)`

Both are correct in isolation, but anyone grepping the helper name across modules (the PR deliberately mirrors the same extraction pattern in both files) will assume one canonical order and can swap arguments silently — `params` and `ticketKey` are both objects/strings plausible at each position, so a future copy-paste edit fails quietly instead of loudly. Cheap harmonization: pick one order (e.g. `(ticketKey, params, …)`) for both helpers. Non-blocking, style-only.
